", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u043-r0048", "tag": "p", "text": "I waited. Nobody challenged. Then I said:", "sha256": "4ee55c85c62e1c07823e4bb668e634754e0b6aafb711f419beab0574600ed65c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[47]/p[48]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u043-r0049", "tag": "p", "text": "“If there are any who doubt that this field is well and fairly won, I do not wait for them to challenge me, I challenge them.”", "sha256": "4a480a507850dc450ec4fe8e9bf17dcac58d198c0785899e37a5bf394ebc687b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[47]/p[49]", "source_html": "

“If there are any who doubt that this field is well and fairly won, I do not wait for them to challenge me, I challenge them.”

Bang! One saddle empty. Bang! another one. Bang—bang, and I bagged two. Well, it was nip and tuck with us, and I knew it.
